posts.title: Training small models to formalize policies
posts.excerpt: We've been training small open models to translate natural language policies into formal specifications, a step known as policy formalization.

posts.title: Learning How to Cube: training a transformer to guide a SAT solver
posts.excerpt: Our NeurIPS 2026 paper trains a 4B transformer to choose useful SAT splits. With SFT and solver-grounded preference training, it matches the best symbolic heuristic's coverage across five runs.

posts.title: Fidelity Probes: Measuring the gap between code and its specification
posts.excerpt: Fidelity probes — a small, loud diagnostic for specification–code alignment — and the statistical machinery that makes them trustworthy rather than vibes-based.

posts.title: Lightweight Formal Methods for LLM-Generated Code
posts.excerpt: An interactive slide deck walking through symbolic testing, concolic execution, property-based checking, and the lightweight-verification toolchain we use to keep LLM-generated code honest.
